intro: TokenPak's OSS beta is Apache 2.0. Pro-only, roadmap, and unsupported surfaces are marked per capability; an item is not part of the current OSS beta unless the OSS column says Shipped or Preview.

labels.Preview: Available, but still beta-quality or intentionally narrow.
labels.Documented pattern: Documented guidance or recipe, not a blanket product guarantee.
labels.Pro only: Requires the TokenPak Pro distribution or daemon.
labels.Roadmap: Planned or under design; not in the current OSS beta.

features.notes: Runs locally on 127.0.0.1 and forwards requests to the configured model provider.
Use the documented provider and client guides. Broad any-provider claims are out of scope for the beta.
Recipes describe fallback patterns; the OSS beta does not guarantee automatic failover for every request.
Spend Guard blocks configured runaway requests before they reach the provider.
Deterministic context reduction for eligible workloads. Savings depend on workload, provider pricing, and cache eligibility.
Built-in profiles are configurable; measure your own workload with the local savings tools.
Local usage records distinguish TokenPak effects from provider/client cache effects.
The demo is an offline smoke test, not proof of live customer savings.
Reads local telemetry and request records; hosted/cloud dashboards are not part of the OSS beta.
Use status and savings commands for local attribution and troubleshooting.
Use a custom exporter over local records if you need Prometheus-style metrics.
Guides cover the documented beta clients; each client still sends requests to its configured model provider.
Headers, manifests, and conformance references are public beta surfaces.
Local indexing and search are available; behavior is bounded by the documented beta limitations.
